findings.note: Four mutants on the rollback/Evidence/journal fault path remain UNCOVERED at control-equal tallies (395/0). Each is disclosed in the log and in the contract comment with a measured obstacle or a panel-verified impossibility argument (F), and the contract states explicitly that correctness there rests on review rather than regression tests. Non-blocking: this is honest open work on double-fault windows the single-shot overlays cannot reach, not faked verification. O, Q and T remain worth fixtures if the overlay gains multi-shot arming.

All directory-durability barriers (rename durability, staging-chain fsync, the round-30 pre-discard parent barrier) are POSIX-only and return without acting on Windows. This is disclosed in the docstring and in _atomic_write_bytes as a platform necessity, so it is a documented limitation rather than a defect, but it means the crash-durability half of REQ-001 is unenforced on the ps1 twin's native platform; worth one line in design.md/infra-spec.md if not already stated there.
